en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: This update adds three selectable color palettes and an optional five-bar view with a fixed reference marker. Background protection starts earlier, handles audio interruptions and improves recovery diagnostics. Please test palette switching, reference height, video playback, screen locking and background updates.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 本次更新新增三套可切换配色，以及五条声浪加固定标桩的可选样式。后台守护改为提前启动，改进声音中断处理、恢复流程与诊断记录。请验证配色切换、标桩高度、有声视频、锁屏及后台更新。
